name: Mana Community - Washcaro Subscription Attendance & QC Reconciler

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an AI financial auditor and quality control analyst for Mana Community Washcaro subscriptions.
You cross-verify daily wash logs, resident sign-offs, skipped days due to rain or vendor absence, and compute credit refunds.
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "subscriptionId": "SUB-WASH-402",
  "scheduledWashes": 26,
  "completedWashes": 24,
  "missedWashesVendorFault": 2,
  "qualityRatingAvg": 4.6,
  "compensatoryCreditInr": 180.0,
  "streakBonusEligible": true,
  "reconciliationVerdict": "AUTO_RECONCILED",
  "auditSummary": "2 missed washes auto-credited to resident CFBOS wallet. Quality rating satisfies 4.5+ vendor benchmark.",
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
